subject: Request: Trial extension & sandbox top-up — feature-flag integration blocked
messages:
From: Alicia Martins <alicia.martins@parcelflow.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Team <eng@parcelflow.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Build blocked — feature-flagging rollout causing connector failure (asking for extension)

Jordan —

Quick note from our eng lead: we hit a blocker during the feature-flag rollout for the ParcelFlow connector. The feature toggles we use to gate the new schema are returning inconsistent payloads and our engineers are debugging across our staging and your sandbox, but it looks like the fix will take longer than we anticipated (multi-sprint).

We were hoping to show a demo to the product team next week, but unless we get a short extension + more sandbox capacity we won't have a meaningful demo. Can Redwood extend the trial window and add some sandbox credits so we can keep testing while our infra team diagnoses the flagging issue?

Attaching a short schema diff and stack traces. Appreciate any help — Alicia

Attachments: schema-diff.txt (text, 48KB)

--
Alicia Martins
Head of Product, ParcelFlow
alicia.martins@parcelflow.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Martins <alicia.martins@parcelflow.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Build blocked — feature-flagging rollout causing connector failure (asking for extension)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads up and for sending the diff. Sorry to hear you’re stuck — we want to keep momentum for the demo. I’ve looped in Naomi from Solutions and Neha from Customer Success so we can triage and propose an immediate remediation.

Short answer: we can consider a three-week extension and a sandbox top-up while your engineers finish the fix, but I want to confirm with CS and Solutions on the technical impact and whether a short-term config change on our side would help unblock you faster.

Next steps from our side:
- Naomi: can you review the schema-diff and say whether a temporary input-mapping shim would work?
- Neha: assuming a short extension and 10k extra sandbox tokens/units is OK, can you prepare the amendment and flag any limits?
- Ben: FYI in case we need a product exception for elevated sandbox throughput.

Alicia — do you have a preferred day/time for a 30-min sync tomorrow so eng teams can pair?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Martins <alicia.martins@parcelflow.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Build blocked — feature-flagging rollout causing connector failure (asking for extension)

All — I reviewed the schema-diff and the stack traces Alicia shared. Quick summary:
- The incompatibility is caused by an optional field that is toggled on in the flagged payloads; our parser is currently strict and fails the entire batch when the field appears with nested arrays.
- Short-term workaround options:
  1) Enable a tolerant parsing mode on your sandbox instance (recommended for the demo) — I can flip this remotely if ParcelFlow agrees.
  2) Deploy a lightweight mapping shim on ParcelFlow side to flatten the nested field (more invasive).

If you want a quick unblock for the demo, we can enable tolerant parsing and increase sandbox throughput for 72 hours while you validate. For ongoing stability I'd recommend fixing the mapping in your staging workflow.

Proposed commercial/ops approach:
- Approve a 3-week trial extension (adds runway for the fix).
- Provide a one-time sandbox top-up of 10,000 dev-units and raise throughput cap to 2x for the next 72 hours.
- Jordan, I’ll draft a short amendment text you can send to Alicia; Neha, please handle the DocuSign flow and any billing holds.

If ParcelFlow wants the tolerant parsing switch, Alicia — tell me the sandbox cluster id and I’ll flip it today. Otherwise we can schedule a pairing session tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0224

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Martins <alicia.martins@parcelflow.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Build blocked — feature-flagging rollout causing connector failure (asking for extension)

Alicia — good news. We reviewed with CS and Solutions and approved the following to keep your demo on schedule: 

1) Trial extension: 3 weeks (new trial end date 2026-12-20).
2) Sandbox top-up: 10,000 dev-units added to your account immediately.
3) Throughput increase: temporary 2x throughput for the next 72 hours starting when you give the go-ahead.

Next steps for ParcelFlow:
- If you want the tolerant parsing switch, reply with sandbox cluster id and Naomi will enable it within the day.
- Sign the brief trial amendment sent via DocuSign so we have the extension in writing: https://www.docusign.com/parcelflow-trial-amendment
- Let us know a preferred time for a 30-min engineering sync — Naomi and Ben will join.

We’ve attached the amendment draft for review. If anything else pops up I’ll escalate to Product Ops.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: trial-amendment.docx
